retrievalProfile.description: A high-key minimalist composition featuring a magnifying glass revealing intricate circuit board details against a stark white void.
triggerTerms: white space with central magnifying glass
excludeWhen: dark or moody lighting is requested
organic or natural subjects are the focus

recipe.visualDefinition: A central magnifying glass with a chrome and black handle is positioned diagonally on a pure white field. The lens magnifies a small section of a computer circuit board, showing gold traces and black components, with a stylized script logo integrated into the circuitry. The overall lighting is bright and even, creating a clean, clinical aesthetic.
coreVisualRelationships: diagonal alignment of the magnifying glass handle
stark contrast between the white background and the detailed lens interior
magnification effect distorting the edges of the circuit board
integration of typography within the magnified subject area
coreInvariants: chrome and black magnifying glass hardware
visible circuitry traces within the lens

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The magnifying glass is the central subject, occupying the middle third of the frame at a 45-degree angle.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The circular lens of the magnifying glass acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the handle from the bottom left toward the lens in the center, then moves to the top left corner where secondary text resides.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space surrounds the central object, emphasizing precision and clarity.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, low saturation overall, with localized high saturation within the lens.

letterConstructionRules: Top-left text uses a clean, light-weight geometric sans-serif with open counters.
Internal lens text uses a thick-stroked, interlocking script with heavy outlines.
The script is integrated into the circuitry pattern.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'C' in the script is oversized and acts as a container for the rest of the word.
Sans-serif 'g' has a modern open-loop descender.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a clinical, modern sans-serif and a decorative, retro-style script.

preserve: Light weight of the top-left text
Heavy outline of the script text
Integration of script into the circuitry

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, clean aesthetic of the top-left text.
Provides the necessary weight and interlocking flow for the lens logo.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key studio photograph of a magnifying glass with a chrome handle lying diagonally on a pure white surface. The lens should show a magnified view of a complex computer circuit board with gold traces.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add light grey geometric sans-serif text in the top-left corner. Inside the magnifying glass lens, overlay a bold script logo with a thick black outline and pale yellow fill, ensuring it appears distorted by the lens curvature.

verificationChecks: Is the magnifying glass handle at a diagonal angle?
Does the lens show a magnified circuit board?
Is the script logo integrated into the circuitry inside the lens?

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp focus on the lens contents

postGenerationChecks: Ensure typography alignment matches the layout
Confirm no artifacts in the white negative space
recipe.reuseFormula: Minimalist Object + Magnified Detail + High-Key Background + Integrated Typography
